$meta.howRead: Guide bodies are client-rendered from a CMS endpoint, https://g.nexonstatic.com/maplestory/cms/v1/ms-guides/<id>. All 27 non-video guides were fetched and full-text searched, so every 'absent' verdict below is an absence across the WHOLE official guide corpus, not just one page. Tables were read with document.querySelectorAll('table') so the cells are real cells.
$meta.stalenessWarning: THE MAPLE GUIDES ARE STALE. The newest version named anywhere in the guide corpus is v.270 (July 22, 2026). v.271 shipped September 9, 2026 - four days before this read - and it changed every symbol income number. Where the guide and the v.271 patch notes disagree, the patch notes win, and the repo already has the patch-note values. Treat guide page 5901's income figures as the PRE-v.271 baseline, which is exactly what they turn out to be.

newFacts.fact: Arcane River Special Content is a SEPARATE weekly income stream from the weekly quest: 6 pieces of content, 15 coupons per clear, 3 clears per week = 45 coupons per area per week.
newFacts.quote: These are weekly Special Content challenges, each of which will reward 15x Arcane Symbol Coupons for their respective regions, and can be completed up to 3 times per week.
newFacts.whyItMatters: lib/symbols.ts IncomeOptions has exactly one weeklyPerArea field. The v.271 patch note's 80 is the WEEKLY QUEST. The special content's 45 is a different source and 15 x 3 != 40, so it is not the same quest renamed. If both run, per-area weekly income is understated. The per-clear 15 is confirmed individually on all six: Erda Spectrum (Vanishing Journey), Hungry Muto (Chu Chu Island), Midnight Chaser (Lachelein), Spirit Savior (Arcana), Ranheim Defense (Morass), Esfera Guardian (Esfera) - each page says 'Coupon x15'.

newFacts.fact: Completing LATER regions' stories retroactively cheapens earlier regions' dailies and grants auto-completes of their weekly special content: one auto-complete for the next region's story, a second for the one after.
newFacts.quote: Completing the next region's story will reduce the number of enemies to defeat by 200, and allow you to auto-complete the weekly Special Content mission once per week for the same reward.
newFacts.whyItMatters: This is exactly the 'turn level-this-symbol-next into a real date' mechanic the brief asked for. For a Lv. 245 character who has cleared every Arcane River story, all six regions are at the floor: the daily is 200 enemies and TWO of the three weekly special content runs are free. The guide continues: 'Completing the following region's story as well will further reduce the number of enemies to defeat, down to a total of 200 enemies, and give you a second auto-complete for that region's Special Content mission.' Time cost per area per week is therefore 7 short dailies plus ONE actual special content run, not three.

newFacts.fact: Vanishing Journey and Chu Chu Island dailies pay HALF the standard amount, made up by a second daily quest elsewhere in the region.
newFacts.quote: The Daily Quest will only reward 10x Arcane Symbol Coupons in these regions on completion.
newFacts.whyItMatters: The repo's ARCANE_DAILY_PER_AREA is a single number applied to all six areas. VJ and Chu Chu are exceptions, and the make-up quest is named: 'An additional 10x Arcane Symbol Coupons can be earned by completing the Reverse City quest (for Vanishing Journey) or Yum Yum Island quest (for Chu Chu Island)'. Post-v.271 these halves presumably double with everything else, but the patch note says 'for all areas' without restating the split - so the SPLIT is sourced and the post-patch magnitude of each half is not. A player who skips Reverse City / Yum Yum Island earns half rate in those two areas, which are also the two cheapest to level.

newFacts.fact: Sacred dailies require 500 enemies, and each Grandis region has ADDITIONAL daily quests worth 10 more symbols beyond the main one.
newFacts.quote: Other daily quests can be completed in each region, which will reward 10x Sacred Symbols for that region.
newFacts.whyItMatters: sacredIncomeFor() models one daily per area and zero weekly. There is a second Sacred daily stream the repo does not count at all, and the 500-enemy requirement ('Each region has a Daily Quest, which requires 500 enemies to be defeated') is the time price that makes Sacred dailies materially more expensive than Arcane ones.

newFacts.fact: Full per-level values and caps for every hyper stat line.
newFacts.whyItMatters: The repo can ORDER and now PRICE hyper stat lines but has no table of what a level BUYS, so it cannot answer 'what do my unspent points get me'. Several lines have a Lv. 6+ or Lv. 11+ breakpoint that makes the naive per-level assumption wrong. Full table: STR/DEX/INT/LUK 30/level max 450; HP% and MP% 2/level max 30%; DF/TF/PP/MANA 10/level, MAX LEVEL 10, max 100; Critical Rate 1/level then 2 at Lv. 6+, max 25%; Critical Damage 1/level, max 15%; Ignore Defense 3/level, max 45%; Damage 3/level, max 45%; Boss Damage 3/level then 4 at Lv. 6+, max 55%; Normal Damage 3/level then 4 at Lv. 6+, max 55%; Status Resistance 1/level then 2 at Lv. 6+, max 25; Attack Power & Magic ATT 3/level, max 45; EXP Obtained 0.5/level then 1 at Lv. 11+, max 10%; Arcane Power 5/level then 10 at Lv. 11+, max 100.

newFacts.fact: ARCANE POWER IS A HYPER STAT LINE worth up to +100 Arcane Power, gated behind 5th Job.
newFacts.quote: Note: You need to advance to your 5th Job in order to increase the stats for Arcane Power Hyper Stats.
newFacts.whyItMatters: lib/symbols.ts derives Arcane Power purely from symbol levels (120 + 10 x sum) and CROSS-CHECKS it against the stat window reading. That cross-check has an unmodelled +0..100 term in it. For Archerroni the line is at 0 so 1,070 reconciles to 95 symbol levels cleanly - but for any character with points in it, checkArcanePower() will report a false mismatch and NO_ARCANE_LEVELS_WHY will be quoted for the wrong reason. The line scales 5/level to Lv. 10 then 10/level, reaching 100 at Lv. 15.

newFacts.fact: Hyper stat points are granted on a published per-level schedule totalling 1,699 points at Lv. 300.
newFacts.whyItMatters: This is the missing half of the pricing question: the repo can now say what a line COSTS and what a character can AFFORD. Schedule: 140-149:3, 150-159:4, 160-169:5, 170-179:6, 180-189:7, 190-199:8, 200-209:9, 210-219:10, 220-229:11, 230-239:12, 240-249:13, 250-259:14, 260-269:15, 270-279:16, 280-289:17, 290-299:18, 300:19, Total 1699. DERIVED (not read off the page, shown so it can be checked): Archerroni at Lv. 245 has earned 828 points, and the stated build (DEX 6, Crit Rate 3, Crit Dmg 10, IED 10, Damage 10, Boss 10, ATT 10) costs 40+7+150+150+150+150+150 = 797, leaving 31 unspent. Also derived from the per-level table, that build yields DEX +180, Crit Rate +3%, Crit Damage +10%, IED +30%, Damage +30%, Boss +35% (5x3 then 5x4), ATT +30.

newFacts.fact: Hyper stats reset for a flat 10,000,000 mesos at any time, and three presets swap free.
newFacts.quote: Hyper Stats can be reset at any time at the cost of 10 million mesos.
newFacts.whyItMatters: Makes any hyper stat reallocation the app recommends cost-bounded and reversible - a 10M meso flat fee is nothing at this character's 764% meso rate, so the app can recommend reallocation freely. The guide also notes 'You can also create up to three Hyper Stat Presets ... You can swap between the presets at any time for free', which means boss-vs-training splits cost nothing ongoing.

newFacts.fact: AP is 5 per level and SP follows a 3/6 pattern above Lv. 101.
newFacts.quote: 5 AP is given per level each time you level up, and additional AP is given for specific Job Advancements when leveling up.
newFacts.whyItMatters: Baseline for any AP/stat reconstruction. SP rule, same page: 'you will gain 3 SP on most level-ups, and 6 SP if your level ends in 0, 3, 6, or 9 upon level-up'.

newFacts.fact: Arcane River special content has published entry levels and party sizes.
newFacts.quote: Only characters that are at least Lv. 200 and have completed the Vanishing Journey story quests can enter the Erda Spectrum content through Nina at Lake of Oblivion: Nameless Town.
newFacts.whyItMatters: Gates the weekly income stream by level, which matters for projecting a lower-level alt.
